 This Writ Petition (Civil) Having Come Up For
Admission On 11.12.2025, The Court On The Same Day
Delivered The Following:
 Wp(C) No. 39087 Of 2016 2
 2025:Ker:95610
 Judgment

The writ petition is filed with the following prayers:-
"A) Issue a writ of certiorari or any other appropriate writ, order or direction to quash Exhibits P5, P6, P8, P11, P12, P13 and P14 as illegal and unsustainable in law.

B)
Issue a writ of mandamus or any other appropriate writ, order or direction directing the respondents 1 & 2 to revise the penal bill by taking the assessment period from 1.7.2015 onwards till 7.7.2015.

C) Grant such other reliefs, which are deemed fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case."
2. The learned Standing Counsel on instruction submits that the petitioner paid the entire amount and settled the liability by availing an OTS facility.
This is recorded.
Accordingly, nothing further remains to be considered in this writ petition, and the same is closed as infructuous.

Sd/-
 MOHAMMED NIAS C.P.
